propositions: Close dispatches the completion verifier even when the ticket already carries a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS bound to the exact immutable commit being closed.
The close seam does not consult the ticket's existing signed completion op-cert before calling the provider, resulting in redundant verification.
A reuse check must authenticate the stored completion op-cert and validate that verified-at-sha equals the resolved close target SHA and material fingerprint matches current ticket state.
Eligible same-ref attested PASS records must be reused to return zero provider calls while invalid, stale, changed-ref, or malformed attestations fall through to fresh verification.
The reuse path must produce a close-compatible PASS result that preserves normal close, durable verdict, and post-close signing behavior.
Attestations invalidated by a later reopen or mismatched on SHA, signature, material, or completion status must trigger fresh provider verification.
